name: Melancholy Circus
source:
A curious young boy and his best friend become fascinated with a mysterious, late-night circus. He knows he should stay home as his older sister wants, but the promise of an adventure of a lifetime is too alluring to resist. What lies beyond the circus entrance? That is for you to find out!

[From [url=https://afuera.itch.io/melancholy-circus]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个好奇的小男孩和他最好的朋友迷上了神秘的深夜马戏团。他知道自己应该听姐姐的话待在家里，但一生仅有一次的冒险实在太过诱人，令人无法抗拒。马戏团入口的另一边究竟有什么？答案等着你亲自揭晓！

[来自[url=https://afuera.itch.io/melancholy-circus]itch.io[/url]]
